polityNote: Counties (maakonnad) of the Republic of Estonia from the restoration of independence (20 Aug 1991) to 20 Oct 2017, the eve of the first 2017 reform merger that moved a county border (21 Oct 2017); EST-maakonnad-2017.json (village atoms) takes over from 21 Oct 2017. Atoms: geoBoundaries EST ADM2 (OpenStreetMap/Wambacher 2017, the pre-reform municipalities, Kiviõli and Maidla still drawn apart from Lüganuse; ODbL), assigned by the 2016 ADM1 counties of the same publisher (nested: 0 overlap, 0 hole at 0.02°). A county is the union of its pre-reform municipalities because no municipality crossed a county line between 1991 and 2017 except Lehtse (2005), which is withheld. ① check: union areas against the Statistics Estonia county areas of 31 Dec 2011 (via Statoids) agree within −0.8%…+1.2% for all 15 counties (most −0.4 to −0.6%, the coast and inland water); a missed transfer of the Lehtse size (164 km²) would show as 5–7%.
